project_type: Greenfield PULSE Next.js App Router foundation replacing a deleted AskMongo Vite/Express/MongoDB baseline; the tracked preparation artifacts and future Codex roadmap are present.
language: TypeScript with strict mode and React/Next.js JSX
build_system: The original AskMongo Vite plus Express runtime is deleted in the working tree by design. The tracked preparation foundation provides Next.js App Router configuration, Tailwind CSS v4 integration, npm lockfile, Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright configuration. Do not restore the old MongoDB/Vite runtime.
test_framework: Vitest for runtime-agnostic unit tests, React Testing Library for accessible component tests, and Playwright Chromium smoke tests. PostgreSQL integration tests, Prisma, Auth.js, sensors, audio, and product feature tests are future milestones.
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
test_command: npm run test:unit -- --run && npm run test:components -- --run && npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium
verification_instructions: Work in /Users/shivain/Desktop/chenyun project. Start with git status --short --branch. Read the seven docs under docs/ and the design verdict/review. Run npm ci, npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build, npm run test:unit -- --run, npm run test:components -- --run, npm run test:integration, install Chromium once with npx playwright install --with-deps chromium, then run npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium and npm run pr-check:quick. The root page must render without permissions, network calls, database access, audio, or sensor APIs.
snapshot_or_generated_files: package-lock.json is generated by npm install/npm ci and must be committed with package.json. Playwright reports and Next build output are generated and ignored; do not commit them. No Prisma migration or audio-worklet artifact belongs in this preparation foundation.
environment_constraints: Use the existing branch and shared worktree only; never create a separate worktree and never push. Preserve the deleted AskMongo files and untracked .DS_Store. The PULSE foundation and handoff files are tracked in the current preparation branch; use origin/main or git show HEAD only when comparing with the original baseline. Playwright may require npx playwright install --with-deps chromium. Do not add secrets or real audio/sensor fixtures.
contribution_requirements: The baseline AGENTS.md requires work in /Users/shivain/Desktop/chenyun project, credentials only in ignored .env, and no committed secrets. The baseline README verification uses npm test/build for AskMongo, but the tracked PULSE foundation README uses the explicit scripts in implementation-plan.md. Preserve unrelated deleted files and do not restore MongoDB code.
key_patterns: Use App Router server-safe pages and layouts; keep domain code runtime-agnostic and unit-branded; keep browser APIs in infrastructure adapters; use semantic CSS variables from DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; expose visible status text, keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and 44px controls. This preparation uses only a minimal root page, SignalBadge/Rule primitives, shared contracts, and smoke tests. Do not implement product behavior.
directory_structure: docs/ contains the PULSE product/design/feasibility/engine/architecture/API contracts; .agents/tasks/pulse-preparation/ contains design and implementation handoff artifacts; app/ will contain the Next.js App Router shell; components/pulse/ will contain small accessible primitives; src/domain/ will contain runtime-agnostic contracts; src/infrastructure/ and src/server/ are reserved boundaries; __tests__/ and e2e/ contain the foundation test harness; the old src/, server/, shared/, and Vite files are unrelated deleted AskMongo baseline files and must not be restored.
